name: phoebis-companion
description: Reports session liveness to Phoebis Router and gives the model the pool's allowance

management_url.title: Management URL
management_url.description: Where to report and to read. Empty uses ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. A path prefix is kept.

token.title: Router key
token.description: Empty uses the client's own token variable. A key set here needs the Management URL.

keepalive.title: Cache warming reports
keepalive.description: Report this session's liveness so the router keeps its caches warm.

notifications.title: Start check toasts
notifications.description: Raise a toast beside each transcript line of the start check.

report_title.title: Session title reports
report_title.description: Report this session's custom title to the router's Sessions view.
